The climate in Patras

Patras is about 13 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 33°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 8°C. Around 1050 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in January (about 174 mm). The highest temperature in Patras in 2015–2024 was 40°C (17 July 2024) and the lowest −1°C (8 January 2015).

Best time to visit Patras

The most pleasant weather in Patras is usually in May, September and October: average highs are between 23°C and 28°C, with up to 8 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
